morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中作为完整词根使用；字母 j 对应 /dʒ/。meN- 接 b 时变为 mem-，b 保留，如 membanjiri。

word_family.gloss: 遭水淹；被大量事物充斥

senses.zh_definition: 水漫出并大面积淹没陆地的现象；洪水、水灾。
senses.en_definition: An overflow or accumulation of water that inundates a large area; a flood.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan air menenggelami atau menggenangi kawasan yang luas; bah atau air bah.
senses.nuances: 既可指洪水，也可指洪涝事件。banjir kilat 是突然发生的洪灾，不专指山区洪水。[DBP：banjir](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=244840&keyword=Banjir)

senses.zh_definition: 水量过多而漫溢的；被洪水淹没或积水的。
senses.en_definition: Overflowing with water or affected by flooding.
senses.nuances: 可作状态谓语，如 Sungai itu banjir。日常说 jalan banjir 或 rumah banjir，表示道路或住宅被水淹；正式叙述也常用 dilanda banjir 或 ditenggelami air。[DBP：banjir](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=244840&keyword=Banjir)

senses.zh_definition: 数量极多、涌现或充斥的；口语中也指食物浇满大量酱汁或汤汁。
senses.en_definition: Present in overwhelming abundance; colloquially, covered in a generous amount of gravy or sauce.
senses.nuances: “大量”的比喻义见 DBP。roti canai banjir 是马来西亚点餐口语，指饼浸着或浇满咖喱汁等，并非正式灾害义，也不必然表示加入所有配料。[DBP：banjir](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=244840&keyword=Banjir)

collocations.zh: 浇满咖喱汁的印度煎饼
collocations.en: roti canai drenched in curry gravy

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pihak berkuasa telah membuka pusat pemindahan sementara untuk menempatkan mangsa banjir.
dual_scenarios.zh: 当局已开放临时疏散中心，安置水灾灾民。
dual_scenarios.en: The authorities have opened temporary evacuation centres to accommodate flood victims.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Jalan kat depan rumah aku dah banjir lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Jalan di hadapan rumah saya sudah dilanda banjir.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我家前面那条路已经淹水了。
dual_scenarios.en: The road outside my house is flooded already.
spoken_features: lah 加强告知或感叹语气

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Jalan kat depan rumah aku dah banjir lah. Kau nak datang lagi ke?
messages.ms_standard: Jalan di hadapan rumah saya sudah dilanda banjir. Adakah kamu masih hendak datang?
messages.zh: 我家前面那条路已经淹水了。你还打算过来吗？
messages.en: The road outside my house is flooded already. Are you still planning to come over?

messages.speaker: Hafiz (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Tak jadilah. Aku tunggu air surut dulu, ya.
messages.ms_standard: Saya tidak jadi datang. Saya akan menunggu sehingga air surut dahulu.
messages.zh: 那先不过去了。我等水退了再说吧。
messages.en: I'll leave it for now. I'll wait until the water goes down.

etymology.historical_story: Banjir is commonly traced to Javanese banjir, although its deeper origin is uncertain. In Malay, the physical image of water spreading across land also supports a figurative meaning of overwhelming abundance. This connection helps explain why the same word can describe both an actual flood and an excessive quantity of something. [Etymology reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/banjir), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=244840&keyword=Banjir)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ban-jir 想成“半截”：洪水漫上来，人站在水里只露半截。由“水太多”联想到“东西多得泛滥”；这是记忆联想，不是词源。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈及实际水灾宜照顾灾民感受；询问 Keadaan keluarga kamu bagaimana? 比拿 banjir 开玩笑更体贴。点餐中的 banjir 则是轻松、中性的本地说法。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 新闻、公文与日常交流均可使用灾害义。餐饮义适合嘛嘛档等熟悉本地菜单的场合；需要明确时可说 kuah lebih，表示多加汤汁或酱汁。
